Monica —

Quick handoff for AstraPath Labs (signed yesterday). High level: 12-month term, Dedicated instance across us-west, target go-live 2027-08-15. Primary use case is inference for clinical document summarization (privacy-sensitive). Committed to 99.9% uptime SLA + on-call during first 30 days.

Key items and owners:
- Contract / Financials: Closed, procurement looped (procurement@astrapath.com).
- SOW: attached (SOW-draft-v1.docx) — procurement expects final by 2027-06-10.
- MAP (mutual action plan): attached (RDW-9872-MAP.pdf) with milestones and responsibilities.
- Security: customer requested SOC2 type II evidence; we uploaded package link in HubSpot (see links).
- Data residency: us-west (customer requirement).
- Expected daily token volume: estimated 12M tokens/day at pilot; ramp to 50M tokens/day by month 3.
- Integration notes: they will stream documents via our ingestion API. Dev lead is Sara Liu (sara.liu@astrapath.com).

Risks/asks for CS:
1) They asked for a 2-week post-launch hypercare with dedicated on-call.
2) Procurement is pushing for a 30% credit for first-month failure credits — I pushed back but wanted you to be aware.
3) There are a couple of redlines in the SOW around data retention and audit log access; legal flagged them but we have flexibility on retention windows.

Can you take primary CSM ownership here and confirm kickoff windows? Also confirm if we need a temporary SLA uplift to 99.95% (they explicitly asked) — I left that to you and Vivek.

Thanks —
Ben
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
